title: Error Point Entry
description: One empirical failure pattern entry stored in docs/ERROR_POINTS.json. Each entry records a recurring bug pattern observed during /z-review-all runs, carries a deterministic pattern signature for matching, frequency counters, sightings log, and test-targeting links. Error points drive regression-hardening test generation in /z-test --mode dual.

ep_id.description: Stable identifier. Format: ep_NNN with zero-padded 3-digit sequential number. Once assigned, never reused.

pattern.description: One-line description of the failure pattern in domain terms. Describes what goes wrong, not how to fix it.

pattern_signature.description: Deterministic 16-char hex hash computed from (module_prefix::normalized_finding_class::severity). Used as the primary matching key before any LLM classification. Computed by sha256 of the concatenated fields and truncated to 16 hex chars.

anchor_module.description: Repo-relative path to the primary module implicated in this failure pattern. Set from the first sighting's evidence file path.

failure_class.description: One-line domain-term description of the real-world bug this error point represents. Mirrors INVARIANTS.json failure_class convention.

severity.description: Severity tier from the finding. blocker = must fix before merge. major = strongly discouraged. minor = informational.

frequency.description: How many review runs have sighted this pattern. Capped at 1 increment per review run (rate-limiting). Starts at 1 on creation.

first_seen.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this error point was first sighted (generated_at of the review run that created it).

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent sighting. Must be >= first_seen.

sightings.description: Ordered list of sightings, newest first. Ring-buffer capped at 20 entries.

run_id.description: ID of the review run that produced this sighting.

finding_id.description: ID of the finding within the review run.

module_path.description: Repo-relative path to the file where the finding was observed.

novelty_score.description: Computed as 1 / (1 + frequency). High-frequency patterns have low novelty. Used in ranking to boost rare patterns.

last_test_pass.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent test pass targeting this error point. null if never tested.

last_test_fail.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent test failure. null if never failed.

tests_targeting.description: List of TEST-NNN IDs from TESTS.md that target this error point. Populated by z-test Phase 6 cross-linking.

archived.description: True when this error point has been pruned (tests_targeting non-empty, no recent sightings, low frequency). Archived entries are excluded from test generation but remain in the matching index for resurrection.

archived_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this error point was archived. null for active entries. Required when archived=true.
